title: Make 10 With a New Pair: 6 + 9
objective: Apply the full Make 10 strategy independently to a pair not explicitly drilled in this unit, confirming transfer within the single-digit range.
studentQuestion: You haven't practiced this exact pair yet — can you still do it?

teaching.setup: 6 + 9, unsolved, presented without a worked model first.
teaching.see: Which addend is closer to 10? (9, needing 1.)

examples.transfer: This lesson is itself the unit's transfer checkpoint — the two-digit extension is deferred to Unit 2.1's lesson 2.1.6, not attempted here.

mastery.evidence: Independently and correctly executes the full bridge for 6 + 9 without a worked model shown first.
